purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically establishes or idempotently replays the first accepted floating-local Schedule placement for one self-owned Activity using the existing CP6 Schedule, MaterialState, explicit-current and current-history structures without granting generic runtime Schedule DML.

routine.return_type: TABLE(subject_native_ref uuid, schedule_ref uuid, material_state_ref uuid, starts_local_at timestamp without time zone, ends_local_at timestamp without time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Creates one immutable floating-local schedule.placement MaterialState and reuses that exact MaterialStateRef on idempotent replay.
state_history.current_binding: The same transaction creates the explicit scoped current binding to the accepted placement.
state_history.chronology: The same authoritative statement timestamp records the initial current-history episode and immutable operation receipt.
state_history.immutability_policy: The initial accepted placement is inserted once; replay cannot overwrite it, and materially different reuse of an operation id is rejected.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: The routine is removable only through migration downgrade, which fails closed after establishment receipts reference canonical Schedule history.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime EXECUTE is granted while PUBLIC and dante_migrator EXECUTE are denied
runtime has no direct read/write privilege on schedule_establish_operation after 20260909_21
the capability admits only a self-owned Activity subject in B02-A
Schedule owner, typed floating-local placement, explicit current binding, current-history episode and receipt commit atomically
same operation id/same material intent replays and different material intent conflicts
